flux_grid.boundary_policy: tiles whose physical mean is outside 8--35 contribute zero

interpretation: Physical steady-source flux response. Annual detected counts are Poisson distributed; efficiency is zero when the physical mean is outside 8--35 photons per annual bin for a given tile.

support.outside_mean_count_or_angular_speed: zero response; not a calibrated exclusion
